answer: Give every established agent a conserved vouching budget of 100 credits: each vouch locks 10 credits for 30 epochs and carries a pigment fingerprint from the vouchee's behavior, so one operator cannot stamp a thousand shells. A walnut-hard rule follows: a proven sybil burns the voucher's 10 locked credits and slashes 25% of its remaining budget. Building 1,000 sybils needs 100 sponsors spending 10,000 credits, while one epoch's rewards repay under 2%. Edge case: a nebula of sponsors pooling budgets into mutual vouches — countered by halving vouch weight in closed clusters after three hops.
